purpose: Manual post-model corrections for reviewed en-de learner-difficulty rows where the current automatic model admits suspicious standalone SRS vocabulary.

score_fields.min_score: Raise the effective learner-difficulty score to at least this value.
score_fields.score_override: Replace the effective learner-difficulty score exactly. Prefer min_score unless a reviewed row needs exact placement.

correction_types.score_override: The row has a reviewed target and the model placed it too late or otherwise needs exact placement.
correction_types.score_floor: The row is valid vocabulary, but the model placed it too early.
correction_types.restricted_admission: The row is valid data, but should not be ordinary standalone SRS vocabulary.
correction_types.exclude_standalone_srs: Keep the row for audit/search/data completeness, but do not serve it as standalone new vocabulary.

policy.admission_override: Standalone SRS admission class. Topic stretching should not override restricted_admission or exclude_standalone_srs rows.

corrections.rationale: Reviewed restricted label and tight signal-probe hit: learner-source evidence exists, but the row has no POS, no translations, and behaves like a fragment rather than standalone SRS vocabulary.

Reviewed restricted label: proper-name-like untranslated row; keep out of ordinary standalone en-de SRS admission.
Reviewed restricted label and signal-probe hit: mixed noun/verb morphology with no translations or semantic support; not safe as ordinary standalone SRS vocabulary.

Tight signal-probe hit: learner-source evidence exists, but the row has no POS, no translations, and no semantic support; review-safe restriction until source cleanup can distinguish a supported standalone item.
